description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class named BaseViewEmployeeController within the OrangeHRM application. It manages the rendering of employee view pages, handles permissions, and interacts with services related to employee data and UI components. The class uses traits for configuration and user role management, and implements methods for rendering views, permission checks, and service access.

classes.name: BaseViewEmployeeController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for viewing employee details, managing permissions, and rendering employee-related views in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getPimLeftMenuService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PIMLeftMenuService, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Prepares and renders the employee view page, adding properties for UI components based on the employee number from the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify data groups for permission checks.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the user has the capability to view the employee data, throws exception or forwards if not.

methods.name: setPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Sets permission data for a specific employee in the current context.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Determines if the employee data is accessible to the current user based on roles or if it's a self-access.
